source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: Definition 2 specifies an arbitrary history-measurable joint block assignment distribution with positive unit-level marginals; Theorem 6 supplies block-adaptive AIPW covariance, normality, and Wald coverage. It does not specify predetermined integer treatment counts followed by uniform complete randomization.

Assumption 5.11 requires P(V_T^2 >= v_- n_eff) -> 1 for predictable quadratic variation, while Theorem 5.14 self-normalizes using realized quadratic variation Q_T; it does not assume pointwise realized-QV growth.
